SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.url_token, au.author_id, au.name AS author_name, s.excerpt, s.voteup_count, s.comment_count, s.version_no, s.captured_at, (SELECT string_agg(t.tag_name, ' · ' ORDER BY t.tag_id) FROM article_tag at2 JOIN tag t ON t.tag_id = at2.tag_id WHERE at2.article_id = a.article_id) AS tags, round((ts_rank(a.search_vec, plainto_tsquery('simple', #{kw})) + CASE WHEN #{kw} != '' AND a.title ILIKE '%' || #{kw} || '%' THEN 1.0 - (strpos(a.title, #{kw}) - 1)::numeric / greatest(length(a.title), 1) ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 4) AS score FROM zh_article a JOIN zh_author au ON au.author_id = a.author_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM article_snapshot s2 WHERE s2.article_id = a.article_id ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true
AND (a.search_vec @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{kw}) OR a.title ILIKE '%' || #{kw} || '%') AND a.article_id IN (WITH RECURSIVE sub AS (SELECT tag_id FROM tag WHERE tag_id = #{tagId} UNION ALL SELECT t.tag_id FROM tag t JOIN sub ON t.parent_id = sub.tag_id) SELECT at3.article_id FROM article_tag at3 WHERE at3.tag_id IN (SELECT tag_id FROM sub))
ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST, s.voteup_count DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT a.article_id, a.title, a.url_token, au.author_id, au.name AS author_name, au.headline AS author_headline, a.publish_time, a.first_seen_at, a.last_seen_at, a.latest_version_no, s.voteup_count, s.comment_count, s.captured_at, s.excerpt, s.content, s.content_html, length(coalesce(s.content, '')) AS content_len, (SELECT string_agg(t.tag_name, ' · ' ORDER BY t.tag_id) FROM article_tag at2 JOIN tag t ON t.tag_id = at2.tag_id WHERE at2.article_id = a.article_id) AS tags FROM zh_article a JOIN zh_author au ON au.author_id = a.author_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM article_snapshot s2 WHERE s2.article_id = a.article_id ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE a.article_id = #{id}

SELECT version_no, captured_at, voteup_count, comment_count, voteup_count - lag(voteup_count) OVER (ORDER BY version_no) AS delta, length(coalesce(content, '')) AS content_len, excerpt FROM article_snapshot WHERE article_id = #{id} ORDER BY version_no
SELECT version_no, captured_at, voteup_count, comment_count, content, content_html FROM article_snapshot WHERE article_id = #{id} AND version_no = #{v}
